Update today

1. Adding random locations to create functional buildings of scene units, special units can be produced after occupation: Planet Destroyer (Dead Star), "Independence Day" alien mother ship, Green Warship.

3, increase the surface scale function of random maps, and set up large or super large maps to support the island warfare more fully.
4, optimize the same screen unit too many problems, to ensure a sense of fluency.
5, adjust laser effect, even more cool effect.


Have a good time!
